not_en: Real Mars orbital & terrain layers (Package v5): Global USGS Viking MDIM 2.1 color mosaic (z0-z5), MOLA/TES/Radiation/Dust tiles (z0-z4), Jezero 20 m CTX region (86 x 107.5 km), and central 5 m HiRISE Perseverance area (~20 x 21 km).

katmanlar.kaynak: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA Ames Research Center — Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic 232 m (MDIM 2.1, Mars_Viking_MDIM21_ClrMosaic_global_232m; tile pyramid via OpenPlanetaryMap)
katmanlar.lisans: Public Domain (17 U.S.C. § 105, U.S. Government Work — USGS / NASA; free for all uses)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: True/visible-color Mars appearance compiled from Viking Orbiter 1 & 2 mosaics (native 232 m/px MDIM 2.1, served here as a z0–z5 global pyramid at ~3 km/px). Visual context only; route distances, slopes and hazards are computed strictly from the local 20 m CTX / 5 m HiRISE grids.

katmanlar.kaynak: MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 pixels/degree (megt90n000eb), PDS Geosciences Node; Smith et al. 2001, JGR 106, 23689
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Global screening at ~6 km cells only: shows where landing is clearly ruled out by altitude, latitude or thick dust. Local slopes and rocks need CTX/HiRISE data, which is why the detailed study area is Jezero.

katmanlar.kaynak: MGS TES bolometric albedo 7410 m, USGS Astrogeology (Christensen et al. 2001)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Global screening at ~6 km cells only (high albedo + low thermal inertia indicates thick dust).

katmanlar.kaynak: TES nighttime thermal inertia, Putzig and Mellon 2007 (Icarus 191, 68), via ASU JMARS map server, resampled to 0.1 deg
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Global screening at ~6 km cells only: low values indicate fine dust/sand, high values indicate rock or duricrust.

katmanlar.kaynak: Dose-pressure relation: Guo et al. (2018), JGR Planets arXiv:1712.06987 (0.222 uGy/day/Pa, ~220 uGy/day at Gale, valid 700-950 Pa) + MGS MOLA MEGDR hydrostatic column (scale height ~10.8 km, Gale 840 Pa -> Jezero 715 Pa / 19.2 g/cm2)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Seasonal pressure shifts dose up to ~25% and solar activity dominates. Planning context only, not a dosimetry product (Jezero estimated ~247.7 uGy/day, +12.6% vs Gale; thicker shield than 69.6% of Mars).

katmanlar.kaynak: Mars Dust Activity Database v1.1 (Battalio & Wang 2021, Icarus 354; Battalio et al. 2023), MRO MARCI daily global maps, MY 28-32, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.7480334 (CC BY 4.0)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Fraction of observed sols inside mapped storms >= ~10^5 km2 across five Mars years (Jezero storm-sol fraction 0.0021 vs Mars median 0.0223; calmer than 82% of Mars).

katmanlar.kaynak: NASA HLS2 criteria (< +2 km elevation, |lat| <= 50 deg) and TES dust check (TI < 100 and albedo > 0.25)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Global coarse screening (~6 km; 48.4% of Mars suitable). Cannot resolve slopes or rocks; Jezero passes all coarse gates and has rich orbital data.

katmanlar.kaynak: Mars 2020 / MSL criteria (< +0.5 km elevation, |lat| <= 30 deg) and TES dust check (TI < 100 and albedo > 0.25)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Global coarse screening (~6 km). Only 18.2% of Mars passes robotic altitude/latitude/dust gates.

katmanlar.ad_en: CTX image mosaic, 5 m (Murray Lab global mosaic)
katmanlar.kaynak: NASA/JPL/MSSS/The Murray Lab. MRO Context Camera (CTX) Global Mosaic V01, tile MurrayLab_CTX_V01_E076_N16 (Dickson et al. 2024, doi:10.1029/2024EA003555)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Free use for all purposes granted by Murray Lab/Caltech. Shifted by 46 m west and 16 m south to match USGS Mars 2020 CTX orthomosaic; residual offsets up to ~15 m locally.

katmanlar.kaynak: USGS Astrogeology / NASA, Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX orthomosaic JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Map base used for Perseverance terrain relative navigation; covers central 32 x 30 km. Reference for aligning all local layers.

katmanlar.kaynak: 64 USGS Astrogeology CTX DTMs blended with ASP dem_mosaic
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: From the 20 m CTX elevation grid (effective resolution ~75-80 m).

katmanlar.kaynak: Derived from 20 m CTX slope (100 m safe circle), USGS SIM 3464 sand dunes (Aeb), THEMIS TI, and TES dust check (HLS2 thresholds)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: 40 m slope baseline on CTX DEM; lander-scale slopes and rocks under ~75 m are not resolved.

katmanlar.ad_en: Surface hazards: sand & loose soil (20 m CTX)
katmanlar.kaynak: USGS SIM 3464 unit Aeb (eolian bedforms) + THEMIS thermal inertia < 350 caution mask
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Highlights eolian sand ripples/dunes and low-TI loose fine-grained ground. Individual boulders <20 m not resolved.

katmanlar.kaynak: 3x3 Horn slope on 20 m CTX DTM mosaic (40 m baseline)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Effective resolution ~75-80 m; steep scarps at <75 m scale are smoothed (~2° uncertainty).

katmanlar.kaynak: 64 USGS CTX DTMs referenced vertically to MOLA (-3156 m to -520 m)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: From the 20 m CTX elevation grid; absolute height may be off by up to ~20 m.

katmanlar.kaynak: RMS deviation from 180 m moving mean of the 20 m CTX elevation
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: CTX elevation resolves features >= ~75-80 m only; boulders are invisible at this scale.

katmanlar.kaynak: Sun & Stack (2020), Geologic map of Jezero crater and Nili Planum, USGS SIM 3464, scale 1:75,000 (doi:10.3133/sim3464)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Unit contacts interpretive to ~100 m; covers central ~56 x 59 km only (outside = no data).

katmanlar.ad_en: Sky blocked by terrain (radiation shielding context)
katmanlar.kaynak: Sky-view factor (Zaksek et al. 2011; Curiosity RAD ~4-5% dose context Ehresmann et al. 2021)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Information layer only, not used in route cost. Radiation shielding from terrain is a few percent.

katmanlar.ad_en: Shaded relief, HiRISE detail area (5 m)
katmanlar.kaynak: USGS Astrogeology Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM mosaic JEZ_hirise_soc_006 (1 m averaged to 5 m)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Covers central ~20 x 21 km (delta & Perseverance landing zone). True DTM detail is a few metres.

katmanlar.ad_en: Landing suitability: robotic rover (5 m HiRISE)
katmanlar.kaynak: Derived from 5 m HiRISE slope & 25 m RMS relief (Mars 2020 TRN 200 m safe circle, <=15° landable, <=30° marginal)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: 5 m grid from USGS 1 m HiRISE DTM; rocks <1-2 m not resolved.

katmanlar.kaynak: 5 m HiRISE DTM slope (>=20° caution, >30° impassable) and 25 m RMS relief (>0.5 m caution)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: 5 m grid from USGS 1 m HiRISE DTM; rocks under ~1-2 m not resolved.

katmanlar.ad_en: Slope, HiRISE detail area (5 m grid, 10 m baseline)
katmanlar.kaynak: USGS HiRISE DTM 1 m averaged to 5 m (10 m slope baseline)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Resolves local escarpments, crater walls and channels (~20 x 21 km footprint).

katmanlar.ad_en: Elevation, HiRISE detail area (5 m DEM)
katmanlar.kaynak: USGS Astrogeology Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM (-2665 m to -1640 m)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Fine 5 m topography across the Jezero delta front and crater rim escarpments.

katmanlar.ad_en: Roughness, HiRISE detail area (25 m RMS relief)
katmanlar.kaynak: 25 m RMS relief computed on 5 m HiRISE DTM (ince/maliyet/puruzluluk.bin, 0.5 m caution threshold)
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Shows metre-scale surface roughness (25 m window); individual rocks under ~1-2 m not resolved.
